_comment: SYNTHETIC. One fictional employee for the existing synthetic client SYN-UAE-TEST ('SYNTHETIC TEST CLIENT (not a real client)' in client_configs; approved UC-02 test configuration v1). 'extracted' = what reading the onboarding form (template onboarding-form-2026) would return; loaded by sub_agent.documents.providers.MockExtractionProvider into the same OnboardingDocumentExtraction model the DOCX provider returns. 'intake' = what the INTAKE CALLER supplies (email, placement, the form-approval attestation, and the UC-02 fields role_id/manager_id/location/project). Every personal value is a placeholder; nothing here is a real person, number or document. 'intake.uc02.attributes' are the opt-in checklist attributes the intake caller states (UC-02 never infers them); they match the form: visa from outside the country, travel and hotel stay, insurance plan, background verification.

roles.summary: Owns platform services as Synthetic Platform Engineer
responsibilities: Build and operate the platform services owned by the Synthetic Platform Engineer role.
Maintain deployment pipelines for the synthetic onboarding services.
Document service runbooks for the platform team.
